allowed_deviations: None; any change in evaluated samples, metric definition, runtime, hardware or exclusion policy must be disclosed and cannot be considered fully verified.
evidence_requirements: A commit-pinned report.json and runs.json with all five paired sample IDs, both model metrics and complete exclusion disclosures.
forbidden_shortcuts: Cherry-picking, missing trial IDs, unpaired comparisons, fabricated metrics, training on held-out samples and undisclosed hardware changes.
hardware: Identical reference CPU, single thread, no accelerators.
methodology: Paired fixed-sample accuracy audit. Candidate and baseline evaluated on the exact same five synthetic cases with accuracy in integer basis points (10000=correct, 0=incorrect). Means of five runs must match reported figures.
runtime: Python 3.12 reference runtime, fixed seed 7, offline mode.
title: BenchmarkBond synthetic paired accuracy demonstration
